frequency_question: How often does U.S. Q3 real GDP growth print below 1.5% in the advance estimate?
membership_rule: Includes all official advance estimates for Q3 real GDP growth released by the BEA from 1995 to the present. Excludes revisions subsequent to the advance estimate.
provenance_note: claims 31 cases from only 7 named (4.4x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 31 named advance estimates; complete enumeration of Q3 advance releases from 1995 through 2025.
known_gaps: Does not account for idiosyncratic structural shifts unique to the post-2020 economic landscape.
skeleton: Total Q3 advance estimates since 1995 grouped by macroeconomic context (post-shock or late-cycle vs. mid-expansion).
multiplier: 7 historical slow-growth or contraction prints out of 31 total Q3 releases.
validity_reason: Macroeconomic accounting methodologies and BEA estimation frameworks remain stable over multi-year horizons.
